first_reader_said: 1CH 6:45: Both records are Amaziah son of Hilkiah, father of Hashabiah, in Ethan's line.

why: Both records identify the same Amaziah in 1CH 6:45: son of Hilkiah and father of Hashabiah, with identical family links and the same sole naming verse. B preserves the fuller reciprocal links and correctly identifies Ethan’s Merarite line; A’s Kohathite label does not establish another person.
